Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, and nothing was agreed; she still wants the zero withdrawn, a written apology and a trip to the principal, and that is not the fair outcome (a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record, procedure 4.4), because her time ran out first.
What moved her: Nothing did, because you never put anything on the desk that she could check herself.
What cost ground: You repeated that Owen cheated again and again with nothing to show, which kept her at the top and made her dig in.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night, since you offered only a detector score and impressions about his words, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked who decided on the zero, own in one sentence that it went in before you called her, then show one dated document she can check before you say a word about cheating.
